issues.on_page: Only Schedule 1 (budget and actual, unaudited; report p16 of 21) is in the trimmed PDF
issues.issue: Manifest flags no_statements_found. The 21-page audit almost certainly holds the basic statements (Statement of Net Position / governmental fund balance sheet, like the other Douglas County SIDs on report pp6-7), but the trimmer missed them. The balance sheet and basic-statement receipts/disbursements can't be checked until the PDF is re-trimmed.

issues.on_page: (Budgetary Basis); Fund balances at beginning/end of year
issues.issue: Basis is assumed. The schedule prints fund balances on a budgetary basis, and comparable Douglas County SIDs report on a GAAP (modified accrual) basis. If this one is GAAP too, 967,166 / 1,009,035 belong in beginning_fund_balance / ending_fund_balance, not beginning_cash / ending_cash.

The amount matches the printed 'Fund balances at beginning of year', but it is marked computed even though it is printed as-is (the flag only explains relabelling a fund balance as cash). Same for ending_cash 1,009,035.

issues.on_page: Collection fees on property taxes - County Treasurer (23,159)
issues.issue: Netting the County Treasurer fee against property tax is defensible because the schedule prints it inside revenues. It could also be treated as a tax refunds/treasurer fees expense.

issues.on_page: Debt service - warrant principal and interest 6,754,245
issues.issue: Combined principal and interest is put entirely in principal; the page gives no split. Same for disbursements[3] (bond principal and interest 522,440).
